candidates.name: mpc-clip-bridge
candidates.summary: Opt-in LD_PRELOAD addin that gives MPC plugins a socket API to the MPC app's clips

candidates.name: DubStemMix
candidates.summary: Dub mixing console for the Akai MIDImix — mix stems live with sends, dub throws, tape delay and spring reverb. A macOS app, or a plugin for the Akai MPC.

candidates.name: FORCE-Remote-Browser
candidates.summary: Browser file manager for the Akai Force. Cut, copy, paste, rename and delete files on the Force's own drives (internal, SD, USB) from your PC. Unofficial.

candidates.name: forceKitMaker
candidates.summary: Build Akai Force drum kits and synth keygroups programs from your sample library, in the browser
